messages:
alex: Putting together a tiny PLG pilot — want to A/B free-credit seeding vs prompt-template seeding for webinar signups. Thoughts?

maria: Love it. Metric suggestion: activation (first meaningful generation) + short-term retention (>=3 prompts in 7 days). Also include cost-per-activated-user.

jon: I'd vote activation + retention as well. Need to capture which prompt templates actually drive follow-up usage.

ashley: Can we tie credit expiry to onboarding nudges? e.g., credits expire after 7 days and we send 2 nudges (day 1 + day 4) with contextual templates.

alex: Yes — implementation idea: credit cohort gets 100 starter tokens; template cohort gets 3 curated starter prompts + 30 tokens. Run 2-week pilot, randomize webinar landing CTA traffic into arms.

maria: Experiment config draft:
```
{"name":"webinar_seed_vs_template","arms":[{"id":"credits","allocation":0.33},{"id":"templates","allocation":0.33},{"id":"control","allocation":0.34}],"duration_days":14,"primary_metric":"activation_7d","secondary_metrics":["avg_prompts_7d","cost_per_activation"]}
```

jon: Nice. What's our sample target? 1k per arm to detect ~5pp lift?

ashley: We typically get ~250 signups/day from the webinar funnel. Over 2 weeks that's ~3500, so 1k per arm is doable if we reserve 30% of traffic for the test.

alex: Plan: route 30% of webinar CTA traffic to /experiment?arm=seedcredits or templates. @maria can you wire events: experiment_arm, activated, prompt_template_id into GA + BigQuery? Also tag session id.

maria: On it. I'll add the events and a Segment -> BigQuery mapping. Will also create a dashboard for quick-checks.

deploy-bot: Feature flag "webinar_seed_v_template" created in LaunchDarkly and set to off for prod by default.

ashley: :thumbsup: I'll draft the two nudge email sequences and three hero starter prompts for the template arm, share by EOD tomorrow.

alex: Thanks — syncing Thurs 11:00am to roll. Agenda: traffic split, tracking validation, copy review, cost caps.

maria: Calendar invite sent.
